subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should Himalaya leave the bundled starter set through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132, or remain in core with version-current documentation?
rationale: Current main and the latest release still ship the reported defects, but VISION.md favors external optional skills, an active maintainer-owned PR removes Himalaya, and the upstream CLI contract has changed since the original proposal.

options.title: Remove via active PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 as the canonical path, then maintain and publish version-current Himalaya guidance as a ClawHub bundle rather than core content.

options.title: Retain and rewrite
options.body: Keep Himalaya bundled only with a new narrowly scoped documentation update verified against the explicitly supported upstream release and live CLI behavior.

recommendation.title: Remove via active PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 as the canonical path, then maintain and publish version-current Himalaya guidance as a ClawHub bundle rather than core content.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the active maintainer-labeled PR that determines whether the affected skill remains in core.
